title: Uses of the United States potato crop, 2025
description: Bar chart of the main uses of the 2025 United States potato crop, in millions of hundredweight: frozen french fries 159.7, fresh table stock 101.5, chips and shoestrings 58.3, dehydrated products 42.1, seed sold 18.7 and other frozen products 13.4, out of total production of 417.6. Data: USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service, Potatoes 2025 Summary, September 2026.
